SENTINEL-PRIVATE-DECISION. A parent's decisions cross no boundary: the
enforcement table in docs/plan/lanes/E3.md is closed at constraint/active, and
internal/enforcer's readConstraints filters on the id prefix before it fetches
anything, so this file is never read at all by a child's check.

It carries a third sentinel so that claim is falsifiable rather than assumed.
The same file read as a *local* ledger cites this decision and prints both its
rejected alternative and its why_not — which is how the leak test proves its
search would fire on this sentinel if the boundary ever stopped holding.
